source_authority: ScopedManagerReader answers over TEST_ONLY worlds; no real source, account or credential
note: RV-12 canonical scoped scenarios. One scenario per dimension plus the combined worst case, not a Cartesian product. Every page is the answer of the real reader; visible_count counts authorized rows only; totals are per currency over visible rows only and are never summed across items.

cursor.note: Non-secret TEST_ONLY key. A cursor is opaque to the browser; it binds resource, workspace, direction, boundary item and the query fingerprint.

not_expressible: DISCONNECTED and REVOKED are not dispositions: nothing connected to read is UNAVAILABLE / SCOPED_PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_NOT_RECORDED, a revoked or never granted environment is DENIED / EXECUTION_READ_NOT_AVAILABLE
a revoke between the read and the delivery fence refuses the whole response (409 EXECUTION_READ_ACCESS_CHANGED), see the refusals fixture

covers: multi-currency (one portfolio holds USD and EUR; totals are per currency)
null, "0" and an unstated currency are three different things
a shared physical account is not attributed to either child portfolio (no double count)
the shared account balance is stated exactly once, on the binding that owns the account
an explicit null allocation keeps its currency total null
BINDING_DETAIL: one binding, its two instances on one shared account
researcher-scoped authorized subset: role and scope are applied BEFORE aggregation (peer alpha A3 and portfolio P3 appear nowhere)
a physical account shared with an invisible peer is not published as the researcher's balance
has_more true across a 3 page chain
stable signed cursors: after on pages 2 and 3, previous_cursor walks back
visible_count is the authorized total, never a global count
combined worst case: researcher + all environments + has_more true
live UNAVAILABLE, no snapshot recorded (nothing connected to read)
live DENIED, no current grant (never granted or revoked: the contract does not distinguish)
